A Letter to Gaza: #Solidarity #BlackLivesMatter 
Dear Brothers & Sisters in Palestine, I am not Palestinian. But like you, I am not White.
Like you, my people are also victims of our government’s disregard of several international laws; #PalestinianHolocaust #BlackGenocide
@LeftBankBooks I appreciate you all putting this prisoner initiated production on your shelves #prisonlivesmaater #solitarylivesmatter #BlackLivesMatter #EndPrisonSlavery #Abolishthe13th
